about_the_game:
Dimensional Fold: Conquer the Secrets of the Fourth Dimension  

Get ready to stretch your mind and dive into the impossible in Dimensional Fold, a brain-twisting puzzle adventure that puts you in command of a tesseract—a mesmerizing 4D hypercube. This isn’t your average 3D challenge; it’s a journey into the wild geometry of higher dimensions!  

Picture this: a vibrant, interactive tesseract spins before you, its faces glowing with distinct colors to guide you as it warps through unseen space. Your mission? Twist, turn, and fold this mind-bending shape to match each level’s target configuration. It’s a test of wits, spatial mastery, and a little bit of 4D magic.  

The game’s heart beats with six core 4D folds—XY, XZ, YZ, XW, YW, and ZW—each a portal to mind-boggling rotations through the mysterious fourth dimension (W). These folds shuffle the tesseract’s structure in ways that defy intuition, but with vivid visuals to mark each move, you’ll soon predict their wild effects like a pro.  

Take charge with precision: standard folds snap the tesseract a full 90°, but tweak your moves with ALT or CTRL for slick 45° or 22.5° adjustments—perfect for nailing those tricky puzzles. Not sure what’s next? Hold SHIFT to peek at a Fold Preview, or hit Z to undo and rethink your strategy. Stuck? Tap H for a nudge from the Hint System.  

Explore the tesseract from every angle—zoom in with the Mouse Wheel for a close-up or pull back for the big picture. Hit SPACE to let it tumble in Auto-Rotation, unveiling its hypnotic 4D dance. Keep tabs on your genius with the Visual Fold History, tracking every clever move you’ve made.  

Start with a Tutorial (T) to unlock the basics, then conquer 50 brain-bending levels across escalating Difficulty Settings (F1). From simple folds to intricate sequences, you’ll go from novice to 4D maestro. With silky animations, crystal-clear feedback, and smart tools, Dimensional Fold turns cosmic complexity into pure fun.  

This isn’t just a game—it’s your ticket to wrestle with higher dimensions and come out on top. Can you tame the tesseract and claim your place as a master of the fourth dimension? Fold the impossible—play now!

Keyboard Controls

Primary Fold Operations

  • Numpad 1: XY Fold (Red)

  • Numpad 2: XZ Fold (Green)

  • Numpad 3: YZ Fold (Blue)

  • Numpad 4: XW Fold (Yellow)

  • -Numpad 5: YW Fold (Magenta)

  • Numpad 6: ZW Fold (Cyan)

Camera Controls

  • Mouse Wheel**: Zoom in/out

  • Mouse Movement**: Rotate camera view

  • SPACE**: Toggle auto-rotation

Level Navigation

  • Page Up**: Next level

  • Page Down**: Previous level

  • ENTER**: Advance to next level (when target matched)

Gamepad Controls

  • Primary Fold Operations

  • A/Cross: XY Fold (Red)

  • B/Circle: XZ Fold (Green)

  • X/Square: YZ Fold (Blue)

  • Y/Triangle: XW Fold (Yellow)

  • LB/L1: YW Fold (Magenta)

  • RB/R1: ZW Fold (Cyan)

Fold Preview

Hold SHIFT + Face/Shoulder Button: Preview fold result before applying

Camera Controls

  • Right Stick: Camera zoom control

  •   - Pull up to zoom out

  •   - Pull down to zoom in

  • Left Stick Click: Toggle auto-rotation

Level Navigation

  • D-pad Up: Next level (when target matched)

  • D-pad Down: Previous level

  • Game Actions

  • Select/Back: Undo last fold

  • Start/Options: Reset current level
